_comment: Source of truth for ARCHITECTURE.md descriptions. Keys are project-relative paths or globs (* within a directory, ** across directories). An exact path beats a glob; a longer glob beats a shorter one; a file with no entry falls back to its own header comment. Regenerate with: node tools/architecture-map.mjs

files..gitattributes: Git attributes (line endings and binary handling).
files..github/workflows/ci.yml: CI: source gates (Rust fmt/clippy/tests, frontend check, browser contracts) on every push and pull request.
files..github/workflows/release.yml: Release pipeline: builds, signs and publishes platform bundles and updater artifacts.
files..gitignore: Ignore rules: build output, dependencies, local notes (MEMORY.md, todos.md), artifact drop, credentials.
files.VERSION: Single-line product version; keep aligned with package.json, Cargo.toml and tauri.conf.json.
files.AGENTS.md: Binding rules for AI assistants and contributors: architecture ownership, safety invariants, docs and tasklist upkeep.
files.CLAUDE.md: Entry point for Claude: follow AGENTS.md; lists the checks to run before reporting work.
files.README.md: Public README: install, CLI/MCP/GUI usage, verified outputs.
files.MEMORY.md: Local, git-ignored session memory and acceptance evidence.
files.install.sh: Linux installer for the direct engine/CLI.
files.uninstall.sh: Linux uninstaller for the direct engine/CLI.
files.package.json: Root package manifest for repository-level scripts (architecture map, release checks).
files.App/README.md: Instructions for the local artifact drop (built bundles are git-ignored).
files.desktop/CSS_CONTRACT.md: Theme, cascade and responsive CSS contract.
files.desktop/README.md: Desktop app build, test and architecture guide.
files.desktop/UI_OWNERSHIP.md: Which component owns which UI state, side effects, CSS and regression boundary.
files.desktop/package.json: Frontend manifest: dependencies, pinned package manager, build and test scripts.
files.desktop/tsconfig.json: TypeScript configuration for the SvelteKit frontend.
files.desktop/vite.config.js: Vite and SvelteKit configuration (static adapter) for the Tauri frontend build.
files.desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml: Rust crate manifest: Tauri 2 app, library and dependency floors.
files.desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/default.j: Tauri capability set granted to the main window.
files.desktop/src-tauri/icons/**: Application icon set generated from source.svg.
files.desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json: Tauri app, window, bundle and security configuration.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs: Native command surface: module registry, Tauri commands, JSON CLI entry points, settings and dependency flows.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs: Executable entry: GUI, `cli`, `json`, `metadata`, `internal` and `--mcp` mode dispatch.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/mcp_server.rs: Typed local stdio MCP server: tools, tracked jobs, bounded output.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/dependencies.rs: Read-only cached APT installed/candidate version report.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/hdr_metadata.rs: HDR10+ extraction/verification and Dolby Vision preservation or fallback eligibility.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/library_artwork.rs: Confirmed provider/local artwork saves, cache inspection and reviewed purge.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/library_assets.rs: Bounded adjacent-artwork inspection (never reads NFO sidecars).
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/library_metadata.r: Bounded public-provider requests, title-clue parser and metadata review data.
Local name/episode scans, validated templates, rename preview and collision-safe apply.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/metadata_credentia: OS credential-manager storage for TMDB/TheTVDB secrets (desktop UI only).
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/metadata_text.rs: Case-insensitive glob cleanup and release-group suffix policy for metadata text.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/packet_verify.rs: Streams FFmpeg framehash output into fixed-size packet digests.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/reports.rs: CSV run-report schema, locked atomic append, history listing and reading.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/settings.rs: Effective-settings resolver: built-in, user TOML, app profile, folder TOML.
files.desktop/src-tauri/src/validation.rs: Selected-stream, copied-payload, timing, disposition, chapter and HDR output validation.
files.desktop/src/app.css: Shared application CSS: shell, run, upload, settings, reports, repair and recovery selector families.
files.desktop/src/routes/+page.svelte: Application route and coordinator: navigation, native IPC, queue/run orchestration, preferences, and most UI state (scheduled for segregation).
files.desktop/src/routes/+layout.svelte: Root layout; imports the global stylesheet once.
files.desktop/src/lib/HelpCenter.svelte: Help view: workflow guidance and command examples.
files.desktop/src/lib/HomeDashboard.svelte: Home view: environment status, counts, recent activity.
files.desktop/src/lib/LibraryPosterGrid.svelte: Poster-card library grid and per-file actions.
files.desktop/src/lib/LibraryQueueStatus.svelt: Compact queue status and recovery call-to-action.
files.desktop/src/lib/MetadataWorkbench.svelte: Metadata review workbench: provider lookup, associations, organizer and rename previews.
files.desktop/src/lib/Modal.svelte: Native-dialog modal primitive (focus return, Escape, inert background).
files.desktop/src/lib/ReportBrowser.svelte: Run-report history and per-file outcomes, including YouTube Optimize decisions.
files.desktop/src/lib/RunModePicker.svelte: Segmented processing-task picker (check, test, metadata, rebuild).
files.desktop/src/lib/RunProgress.svelte: Run progress bar, ETA and stage display.
files.desktop/src/lib/RunSettingsEditor.svelte: Per-file tune and stream-selection override editor.
files.desktop/src/lib/SettingsPreferences.svel: Settings view: preferences, provider credentials, artwork cache.
files.desktop/src/lib/ToolRepairActivity.svelt: Tool-setup activity and saved logs view.
files.desktop/src/lib/ToolRepairConfirmation.s: Exact-plan confirmation for allowlisted tool repair.
files.desktop/src/lib/YouTubePreparation.svelt: YouTube prep view: Upscale/Optimize mode picker and tuning controls.
files.desktop/src/lib/metadata-match.ts: Pure scoring of provider candidates against filename clues.
files.desktop/src/lib/rename-template.ts: Rename-template token insertion and rendering helpers.
files.desktop/src/lib/report-view.ts: Pure report presentation helpers (metadata cleanup changes, Optimize summary).
files.desktop/src/lib/types.ts: Shared TypeScript contracts mirroring native JSON payloads.
files.desktop/src/lib/updater.ts: Tauri updater wrapper and update UI state machine.
files.desktop/src/lib/workspace-state.ts: Pure queue/run workspace state shape and transitions.
files.desktop/static/svelte.svg: Unreferenced SvelteKit template logo (remove: framework default asset).
files.desktop/static/tauri.svg: Unreferenced Tauri template logo (remove: framework default asset).
files.desktop/static/vite.svg: Unreferenced Vite template logo (remove: framework default asset).
files.desktop/tests/browser/*Harness.svelte: Isolated synthetic-prop fixture harness for a browser component contract.
files.desktop/tests/browser/main.js: Browser fixture entry that mounts the selected harness.
files.desktop/tests/library-contract.mjs: Browser contract: Library grid, selection and review.
files.desktop/tests/metadata-match.test.mjs: Unit tests for metadata candidate matching.
files.desktop/tests/modal-contract.mjs: Browser contract: modal focus, Escape and background inertness.
files.desktop/tests/responsive-contract.mjs: Browser contract: six-width responsive snapshots across all themes.
files.desktop/tests/run-contract.mjs: Browser contract: Run setup and progress.
files.desktop/tests/support-contract.mjs: Browser contract: reports, settings, repair, recovery.
files.desktop/tests/workspace-state.test.mjs: Unit tests for the workspace state module.
files.docs/architecture-descriptions.json: Descriptions, retirement list and line budgets that drive ARCHITECTURE.md.
files.docs/screenshots/*: Themed application screenshots used by the README.
files.hevc_rebuild/app.py: Python engine orchestration: rebuild runs, CLI entry (retiring).
files.hevc_rebuild/bridge.py: Python bridge between the Rust app and the engine (retiring).
files.hevc_rebuild/discovery.py: Python discovery adapter over the Rust walker (retiring).
files.hevc_rebuild/encode.py: Python encode orchestration and resource planning (retiring).
files.hevc_rebuild/util.py: Python shared helpers and CSV report writer (retiring).
files.tests/fixtures/resource_plan_cases.json: Shared resource-planner fixture cases (Python/Rust parity; retiring with Python).
files.tests/test_*.py: Python engine or Rust-parity test (retiring with the Python engine).
files.tools/normalize-linux-appimage.sh: Post-processes the Linux AppImage for portability.
files.tools/verify-release-manifest.mjs: Verifies release manifest hashes and artifact names.
files.desktop/src/lib/queue-paths.ts: Pure queue path helpers (normalize, containment, remap, display name) extracted from the route; tested by test:queue-paths.
files.desktop/tests/queue-paths.test.mjs: Node characterization tests for queue-paths.ts (POSIX, Windows drive and UNC paths).
files.tools/tasklist-check.mjs: Validates dated tasklists (newest wins), lists open items, flags missing Files/Open questions/Supersedes.
